summary.text: Flower Forest Forbidden Land is one of the ten great fierce areas in Northern Plains, a vast forest of tree-sized mushrooms and flower fog that shelters desolate beasts.

claims.text: After sending off Nine Spiritual Fairy, Lin Jian Xing heads north into Northern Plains, turns invisible, and soon arrives at Flower Forest Forbidden Land. It is one of the ten great fierce areas in Northern Plains and is home to countless mushrooms as large as trees, forming a vast forest. All kinds of flowers bloom there, their aroma dense enough to form fog. Like other fierce areas, countless desolate beast groups live here, including many immemorial desolate beasts and plants.
Tree-sized mushrooms form a vast forest, and blooming flowers fill the air with aroma dense enough to become fog.

Zuo Ye Hui has been hiding in the depths over these days. As a legendary immemorial desolate beast it finds fierce areas easier to enter than Gu Immortals do, and this fierce area is nearest to Longevity Heaven for a plan to save You Tian Guang. It brings Lu Qing Ming and Su Guang here after catching them on their way toward Western Desert. Under a silent dark path immortal formation, immemorial beast groups run mad and form a beast tide that breaks out of the fierce area toward nearby Huang Jin tribes, who ask Longevity Heaven for help. Lin Jian Xing arrives in the sky above the fierce area as that unfolds.

Even before the tribes ask for help, Longevity Heaven detects the commotion. Discussion notes that Flower Forest Forbidden Land has a dense number of dark path dao marks. Bing Sai Chuan moves directly there to inspect while others guard Longevity Heaven. He lands quietly, traces aura toward Zuo Ye Hui’s formation, and later Longevity Heaven sends Immortal Gu Houses and Gu Immortals toward the fierce area. Lin Jian Xing had come secretly for rare immortal materials for a sword forest killer move and treats the beast tide as useful cover.
